Return distinct IC50 activity records (in nM) against the human single-protein target CHEMBL4822 (Beta-secretase 1). For each qualifying activity row, include compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer PubMed ID, fall back to DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Only include rows where canonical_smiles is not null and at least one of pubmed_id or doi is available.
